title: policy.json: ids
description: Tracker ID allocation (design part 3.4, ID allocation). Only the orchestrator allocates IDs, on the main branch. A second machine allocates from a reserved block so items created on either machine merge without renumbering.

blocks.description: Reserved number blocks for other machines, for example { "name": "second-machine", "from": 100000 }. The machine's own block is chosen by the HITLD_ID_BLOCK environment variable or the --block option of `hitld work new`; with neither it allocates from the base range, which is every number below the lowest reserved block. Blocks never overlap, and an open-ended block (no "to") must be the highest. `hitld work check` fails on overlapping blocks, and on any two files that share a number.
